guards.name: H1: a path outside the allowlisted subtree must be refused
guards.expect: denies a sibling folder while allowing the real one

guards.name: H1: '..' must be rejected, not resolved away
guards.expect: rejects '..' but allows a name that merely CONTAINS dots

guards.name: H1: an unconfigured allowlist must DENY, never allow-all
guards.replace: if (roots.length === 0) return { ok: true, kind: "file", path: String(raw ?? "") };

guards.name: H1: a root-name prefix must not be treated as being inside the root
guards.expect: is not fooled by a prefix that merely STARTS with the root name

guards.name: H1: the account root must never be served as a file
guards.find: if (roots.length === 1) return { ok: true, kind: "file", path: roots[0] };
guards.replace: if (roots.length === 1) return { ok: true, kind: "file", path: "" };

guards.name: H4: a signed-in user with no profiles row must NOT become a super
guards.replace: return (profile as CurrentUserProfile | null) ?? { id: user.id, email: user.email ?? "", full_name: null, role: "super" };

guards.name: H4: requireRole must deny a null profile
guards.expect: DENIES a user with no profile row

guards.name: H2: a missing INTAKE_TOKEN_SECRET must refuse the production boot
guards.expect: FIRES in production with no secret
